## How I tested it

- [ ] `make test` passes (both Pythons)
- [ ] `make lint` passes (if shell files changed)
- [ ] `make validate` passes (if the plugin, hooks or skills changed)
- [ ] Tried it on my Mac with `make install-dev` from this branch (if install, restore or the shell snippets changed)

## Interface

- [ ] No command, flag, exit code, config key or `--json` field was renamed or removed, or the CHANGELOG says how it changed
- [ ] `docs/json/` matches any `--json` output I added

## Docs

- [ ] README and docs match the change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a line under `## [Unreleased]`
